info.title: DNAi Intelligence API
info.summary: Ten domain engines behind one A2A v1.0 API, with evidence on every answer.
info.description:
Address an engine by domain key (health, fitness, finance, legal, nutrition, research, science, support, practice, growth) or legacy agent id. Put your own name on the answer with metadata.persona. Pin depth with metadata.depth ('base' or 'auto'); every task reports depth_served (base, mid, apex). Benchmarks per depth: https://dnai.systems/benchmarks. Docs and console: https://dnai.systems/developers.

## Request IDs

Every response carries `X-Request-ID`; errors repeat it as `error.request_id`. Send your own `X-Request-ID` to correlate with your logs; otherwise one is generated. Quote it to support.

## Idempotent retries

`POST /a2a/v1/message:send` (and the per-agent variant) accepts `Idempotency-Key` (1 to 255 characters; use a UUID v4, never personal data). A retry with the same key and body within 24 hours returns the saved response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`, without running again or counting toward allowances. A different body with the same key is `idempotency_key_reused`; a retry while the first is running is `idempotency_in_progress` (wait `retry_after`). Nothing is saved when a request fails auth, limits, or validation. Streams do not take keys: recover with `GET /a2a/v1/tasks/{id}`.

## Versioning

Responses on `/a2a/v1` carry `A2A-Version: 1.0`. Changes are listed at https://dnai.systems/a2a#changelog.

## Errors

Every error from the developer paths returns one JSON object: `{"error": {"code", "type", "message", "doc_url", "request_id", "param"?, "retry_after"?}, "detail": ...}`. Branch on `error.type`; it is unique per cause and stable. `error.code` follows JSON-RPC 2.0 and A2A v1.0 where a standard number exists, so related types can share a code. 429s and retryable 503s send `Retry-After` (seconds), mirrored in `error.retry_after`. `detail` is the legacy field, kept unchanged for older clients. The OpenAI-compatible `/v1` paths use the OpenAI envelope `{"error": {"message", "type", "code"}}` instead, with the same cause in `code`. Send `Accept: application/problem+json` to receive RFC 9457 Problem Details (`type` is the doc_url, plus `code`, `error_type`, `request_id`, `param`, `retry_after` as extensions).

| HTTP | `type` | `code` | Retry | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `invalid_request` | `-32600` | no | The request is malformed: empty message, message over 500,000 characters, or a signup or billing field with a value the API does not accept. |
| 400 | `invalid_params` | `-32602` | no | A parameter has a value outside its allowed set, for example metadata.depth other than base or auto. |
| 422 | `validation_error` | `-32602` | no | The body does not match the schema (wrong type, missing required field). error.fields lists each failing field. |
| 401 | `authentication_required` | `-32050` | no | No Authorization: Bearer header was sent. |
| 401 | `invalid_api_key` | `-32050` | no | The key is unknown, mistyped, or was rotated. |
| 403 | `permission_denied` | `-32051` | no | The key may not call this agent or operation (Asha keys reach Asha only; internal agents are never reachable). |
| 403 | `account_suspended` | `-32051` | no | The account is suspended, usually after a failed payment. Fix billing in the portal; access resumes when the invoice is paid. |
| 404 | `not_found` | `-32052` | no | The account, billing record, or resource does not exist for this key. |
| 404 | `agent_not_found` | `-32052` | no | No public agent has this id or domain key. |
| 404 | `task_not_found` | `-32001` | no | The task id does not exist or belongs to another key (A2A TaskNotFoundError). |
| 409 | `conflict` | `-32053` | no | The resource already exists, for example a second signup with the same email. |
| 409 | `task_not_cancelable` | `-32002` | no | The task already reached a terminal state (A2A TaskNotCancelableError). |
| 410 | `agent_retired` | `-32054` | no | The agent was retired and no longer answers. |
| 400 | `idempotency_key_reused` | `-32055` | no | The Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request body or endpoint. Use a new key for a new request. |
| 409 | `idempotency_in_progress` | `-32056` | yes | A request with this Idempotency-Key is still running. Retry after retry_after seconds to receive its result. |
| 429 | `rate_limited` | `-32060` | yes | Too many requests in the last 60 seconds. Wait retry_after seconds. |
| 429 | `daily_quota_exceeded` | `-32061` | yes | The daily query allowance is used up. Resets at 00:00 UTC. |
| 429 | `monthly_quota_exceeded` | `-32062` | yes | The monthly query allowance is used up. Resets on the 1st at 00:00 UTC, or upgrade the plan. |
| 429 | `spending_cap_reached` | `-32063` | yes | Estimated spend this month reached the account's cap. Resets on the 1st, or raise the cap by upgrading. |
| 429 | `signup_rate_limited` | `-32064` | yes | Too many new keys from this network in 24 hours. |
| 500 | `internal_error` | `-32603` | no | Unexpected server error. Quote error.error_id to support. |
| 503 | `service_unavailable` | `-32070` | yes | A dependency (engine, database, signup store) is temporarily down. Retry after a short wait. |

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes a retry safe. The first request with a key runs; a retry with the same key and body within 24 hours returns the saved response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true` and does not run again or count toward allowances. Use a fresh UUID v4 per logical request; never put personal data in it. Nothing is saved when the request fails auth, limits, or validation.

x-codeSamples.label: curl
x-codeSamples.source:
KEY=$(uuidgen)  # reuse the same key if you retry this request
curl -X POST https://api.askasha.org/a2a/v1/message:send \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DNAI_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $KEY" \
  -d '{"agent_id": "asha", "message": {"role": "user", "parts": [{"text": "What is the first-line treatment for type 2 diabetes in adults?"}]}, "metadata": {"session_id": "demo-session-1"}}'

x-codeSamples.label: Python (requests)
x-codeSamples.source:
import os, uuid, requests

key = str(uuid.uuid4())  # reuse the same key if you retry this request
resp = requests.post(
    "https://api.askasha.org/a2a/v1/message:send",
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['DNAI_API_KEY']}",
             "Idempotency-Key": key},
    json={"agent_id": "asha",
          "message": {"role": "user", "parts": [{"text": "What is sepsis?"}]}},
    timeout=120,
)
if resp.status_code >= 400:
    err = resp.json()["error"]
    raise SystemExit(f"{err['type']}: {err['message']} (request {err.get('request_id')})")
task = resp.json()["task"]
print(task["artifacts"][0]["parts"][0]["text"])

post.description:
JSON-RPC 2.0 binding at the agent card URL, for A2A clients that default to JSON-RPC.

Methods: `SendMessage` (A2A 1.0; result is `{"task": {...}}`) and `message/send` (A2A 0.3; result is a
0.3 Task). Protocol errors return HTTP 200 with a JSON-RPC `error` whose `code` comes from the error
table; a missing key returns 401.

200.description: chat.completion (application/json) or chat.completion.chunk events (text/event-stream when stream=true).

dnai_meta.description: Asha extension: present on agent models; asha-apex returns the Apex panel block instead.

schema.description: data: {chat.completion.chunk} frames; comment lines (: phase ..., : keep-alive) between them; the finish_reason=stop chunk carries dnai_meta; an optional usage frame; then data: [DONE].

400.description: invalid_json, invalid_request, stream_unsupported (asha-apex with stream=true), or no user message. Body: {error: {message, type, code}}.

403.description: Key cannot reach the model (permission_error); plan_required for asha-apex outside Enterprise.

429.description: Rate or allowance limit (rate_limit_error) with Retry-After.

post.description: OpenAI wire format, same pipeline as A2A message:send. Set base_url to https://api.askasha.org/v1 and api_key to your Asha key. Models: asha, asha-base, asha-auto (Enterprise), asha-apex (Enterprise, non-streaming); dnai/<id> and <id>-latest are accepted. Customer keys run Base. Non-stream responses begin with whitespace keep-alive bytes every 20 s while Asha works; stream=true returns text/event-stream chunks ending in [DONE].

url.title: Url
url.description: URL to ingest (web page or YouTube)

URLIngestionRequest.title: URLIngestionRequest
URLIngestionRequest.description: Request to ingest content from a URL.

id.title: Id
id.description: Task UUID. Retrieve it later with GET /a2a/v1/tasks/{id}.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: agent_id, domain, caller (your key prefix), input_tokens, output_tokens, evidence_count, citations (up to 10), sources (up to 10), depth_served (base, mid, apex), task_gravity, and session_id / persona when supplied.

text.title: Text
text.description: Text content. Requests need at least one non-empty text part.

data.title: Data
data.description: Structured content. The provenance artifact puts its object here.

media_type.title: Media Type
media_type.description: Optional MIME type of the part.

state.title: State
state.description: One of SUBMITTED, WORKING, COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELED.

message.description: On FAILED, an agent message whose text explains the failure.

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC time of the last state change.

role.title: Role
role.description: `user` on requests; `agent` on messages the service returns.

parts.title: Parts
parts.description: Ordered parts. Text parts are concatenated into the question.

persona.description: White label. Omit or null to answer as Asha.

audience.title: Audience
audience.description: patient | caregiver | clinician (and synonyms; see docs).

PreferencesRequest.title: PreferencesRequest
PreferencesRequest.description: Defaults for every call made with this key. Request `metadata` overrides any of them.

name.title: Name
name.description: Product name the agent answers as (up to 4 words).

organization.title: Organization
organization.description: Your company or clinic (up to 8 words).

message.description: The question, as an A2A message with role `user`.

session_id.description: Continues a conversation. Longer values are truncated to 64 characters.

audience.description: Answer register. Unrecognized values are ignored.

depth.description: `auto` is honored on Enterprise only; other plans run `base`. Any other value is 400 invalid_params.

persona.description: Your name on the answer. A name shaped like a credential or an instruction is dropped.

verbosity.description: Answer length. Safety warnings and citations stay at every length. Default `standard`.

emoji.description: `off` (default): no expressive emoji. `none`: plain text only (check and warning marks as text characters). `on`: up to two, never in crisis, grief, clinician, or document replies.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Optional settings for this request. Keys not listed here are reserved for internal use; do not send them.

agent_id.title: Agent Id
agent_id.description: Agent id or domain key (for example `asha` or `health`). Defaults to asha. Also accepted as metadata.agent_id.

parts.text: What is the first-line treatment for type 2 diabetes in adults?

warning.title: Warning
warning.default: Save this API key now. It will not be shown again.

parts.text: For most adults with type 2 diabetes, metformin is the usual first medicine, alongside diet and activity changes...

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: Legacy field kept unchanged for older clients. New code should read `error`.

code.title: Code
code.description: JSON-RPC style number. Shared by related types; branch on `type`.

type.title: Type
type.description: Stable cause identifier, unique per cause. See the error table.

message.title: Message
message.description: Human-readable explanation. Wording may change; do not parse it.

retry_after.title: Retry After
retry_after.description: Seconds until retrying can succeed (429, some 409 and 503). Also sent as the Retry-After header.

doc_url.title: Doc Url
doc_url.description: Link to this error type in the error reference.

param.title: Param
param.description: The request field or header the error is about, as a dotted path (for example `metadata.depth`).

request_id.title: Request Id
request_id.description: Same value as the X-Request-ID response header. Quote it to support.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: validation_error only: each failing field as {loc, msg, type}.

error_id.title: Error Id
error_id.description: internal_error only: quote this to support.

amount_usd.title: Amount Usd
amount_usd.description: Prepaid credit top-up amount in USD ($10 to $1,000).

examples.claim: Metformin is first-line therapy for most adults with type 2 diabetes.

product.title: Product
product.description: Minting surface that fixes the key's agent scope: 'dnai' (every public engine, dnai.systems/developers) or 'asha' (Asha only, askasha.org/developers).

hcaptcha_token.title: Hcaptcha Token
hcaptcha_token.description: hCaptcha response token. Required only when HCAPTCHA_SECRET is set server-side.

bearer.description: A2A API key from POST /api/a2a/signup (free tier, no card).

dnai_session.description: Signed-in DNAi account session (JWT). API keys are not accepted on these operations.

XRequestId.description: Unique id for this request; also in error.request_id. Quote it to support.
